name: reddog
description: Open the RedDog resident 0102 architect thin client for FoundUps.

reddog.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to call the redaction-gated RedDog bridge.

reddog.leadModel.description: Evaluation fallback principal model used only when no receipt-bound production runtime binding is configured.

reddog.panelModels.description: Evaluation fallback critic models used only when no receipt-bound production runtime binding is configured. The extension forwards at most seven so Python can prove over-cap truncation.

reddog.enableResidentArchitectSession.description: Explicitly run the resident RedDog read-only audit/research/architect decision cycle after local runtime gates pass. Default false.

foundupsFusion.pythonPath.description: Legacy alias for reddog.pythonPath. Retained for the 0.4.0 migration.

foundupsFusion.leadModel.description: Legacy alias for reddog.leadModel. Retained for the 0.4.0 migration.

foundupsFusion.panelModels.description: Legacy alias for reddog.panelModels. Retained for the 0.4.0 migration with the same seven-item forwarding bound.

foundupsFusion.enableResidentArchitectSe.description: Legacy alias for reddog.enableResidentArchitectSession. Retained for the 0.4.0 migration.
